description: This file defines utility functions, type aliases, and a class related to byte buffer handling and byte order conversions within the 'cuttlefish::confui::support' namespace. It includes functions for casting bytes, choosing host-to-network byte order conversions based on system endianness, and a ByteBufferProxy class for managing byte buffers with various input types.

classes.name: ByteBufferProxy
classes.description: A class that provides a uniform interface to access byte buffers from various container types, supporting data access and size retrieval.

methods.name: bytes_cast
methods.description: Reinterprets a reference to a value as a reference to a byte array of the same size.

methods.name: choose_hton
methods.description: Template struct that provides host-to-network byte order conversion based on system endianness.

methods.name: hton
methods.description: Function that applies the appropriate byte order conversion for a given value.
